scope: Read-only final audit of saved-score analysis, generated Table III, manuscript interpretation, and supporting plot. No GPU or new replay.
independent_rechecks: normalized score reconstructed for every saved method including M3_fixed
strict score > 1 exactly reproduces all saved alarm flags
all M0-M4 frozen operating points reproduce
matched thresholds derive solely from 384 controls
tie counts and actual rates reproduce
96 event maxima use lags 0 through 6 inclusive

policy_independence.reason: replay_shock.py acquisition uses calibration trigger and revealed probe innovations before inference. qmacro/qfine/joint are applied only to subsequent alarm logging. Next-update prediction state uses M0 inference output, not alarm flags. ProbePolicy receives its separate trigger, not alarm decision thresholds.

threshold_ties: Strict > excludes tied threshold scores. Each selected real threshold has one equal control. Toy test verifies larger tie blocks. No randomization or interpolation.
localization: No arbitrary-threshold localization is claimed; saved maxima and original alarmed-ID lists do not identify newly crossing affected groups.
maintext_assessment: Table III, caption and surrounding text give correct denominators, actual common rates, window correction, unchanged acquisitions and retrospective limitations. No claim of a validated revised policy, reliable calibration or statistical equivalence.

visual_assessment.result: Pass: readable axes explicitly distinguish per-update control false alarms from per-event detection; circle and open-triangle legends distinguish recomputed lag-0-6 frozen points from published lag-0-5 counts. All five methods visible; no clipping or overlap. Legend does not cover data curves. Supporting figure, not an additional main-paper figure.

remaining_qualifications: Development controls reused for descriptive thresholds; no chronological validation.
Eight shared backgrounds across four weeks constrain inference; no independence-based significance claim.
Detection curve is not a localization curve.
